normal.name: History Chrono
normal.text: #onthisday in 1958, visitors to Brookhaven National Laboratory got their first go at Tennis for Two, physicist William Higinbotham's game on an analog computer with a 5-inch oscilloscope screen. By some definitions, it was the first video game. #ITHistory
